title: Flea Market Mall World?
content: I have a reoccuring dream location that is a neverending flea market. The setting is always the same, it's night time, and when I enter there is a lively row of stalls with a variety of items for sale, and tons of people walking around. There are your typical flea market vendors like knife sellers, knick knacks, fruit and veggies. However, as I walk through the market, the stalls get fewer and farther between. Eventually I get to an abandoned section of the flea market where it seems like everyone has packed up and left already, or has been gone for a long time already. There is a feeling of [kenopsia](https://www.thedictionaryofobscuresorrows.com/concept/kenopsia#:~:text=You%20can%20sense%20it%20when,now%20lie%20abandoned%20and%20quiet). It feels like I have entered a liminal zone outside of time. There are empty tables covered with tarps, abandoned car parked outside, and a feeling that it's past time to have already left. If you've ever been to a flea market on a day it's not opened, you know what I'm talking about. Sometimes when I visit there is one seller with a stall in this area, and it's either a book store with tons of old books, or an antique store with lots of old world artifacts. I try to read what the books on the shelf are, but I always have a feeling that people are waiting on me and it's time to go. I get the sense that there are many interesting and special books waiting to be discovered but I never see what they are. Has anyone experienced anything like this before?
